text:
Elliot Price: Kicking off coordination thread for known-issues sprint docs. Main question: where does the “Known issues + workarounds” hub live (docs site vs Confluence-only), and what naming conventions do we want so Support macros + SDK docs can link consistently?

Dev Patel: +1. Support needs a stable public-ish URL we can paste in replies. Confluence is fine for playbook, but workarounds should be in the external KB (redwood-docs) whenever we can.

Wei Chen: Agree. For Hosted issues at least, we should publish on docs site under a troubleshooting/known-issues area. Confluence can be the internal process + escalation stuff.

Kira Thompson: For Dedicated/Private, some workarounds are borderline “internal runbook” (installer logs, cluster events). We can still publish a customer-safe version, but need a clear rule: what’s eligible for docs vs internal-only.

Owen Phillips: From incident side: please don’t bury things in Confluence. During a P0 we need one canonical link to drop in #support + customer email. If it’s internal-only, we should at least have a customer-safe snippet/macro that doesn’t reference internal dashboards.

Elliot Price: Proposal:
- External docs (redwood-docs): “Known issues & workarounds” hub + all customer-safe workaround articles.
- Confluence: escalation playbook + internal triage checklists + links to the external articles.

Elliot Price: Naming:
- Hub page: `/help-center/known-issues/` (or `/docs/known-issues/` depending on IA)
- Articles: `workaround-<short-slug>.mdx` with frontmatter tags (tier, product area, region, model)
- Titles start with “Workaround:” so Support can scan.

Priya Shah: From macro/snippets side: stable slug is everything. If we have to rename later, we should keep redirects.

Wei Chen: On cross-linking from SDK docs: can we standardize a section name like “Troubleshooting” and add a bullet “Known issues & workarounds” that points to hub? Then per-issue deep link from the relevant SDK page (e.g., streaming).

Mina Haddad: Re: tags: for routing/fallback-related issues, please include “routing” + “fallback” tags even if the symptom is in rate limits or version pinning. Support keeps searching by symptom; Eng searches by subsystem.

Kira Thompson: On eligibility rule: if the steps require customer to access internal-only tools (Grafana, admin console, SRE runbooks), it’s not publishable as-is. But we can still publish:
- symptoms
- what customer can check (request IDs, regions, client timeouts)
- mitigations they can apply
- “When to escalate” + what data to provide

Dev Patel: That works. We should explicitly avoid including customer names, internal incident IDs, internal thresholds, etc.

Elliot Price: +1. I’ll add a “Customer-safe” checklist to the publishing template.

Wei Chen: Where does this sit in nav? I’d vote Help Center > Troubleshooting > Known issues. Not under API Reference.

Elliot Price: Same. There’s a DevEx navigation proposal doc already; I can update with this placement.

Kira Thompson: For Dedicated/Private, maybe we need sub-sections on the hub:
- Hosted API
- Dedicated
- Private
Each shows top known issues + “Last updated” so enterprise customers trust it.

Owen Phillips: Please add a visible “Escalate” callout per article (like: “Escalate if X/Y/Z”), so Support can avoid ad hoc judgement.

Priya Shah: + include “Copy/paste” request for diagnostics. Example:
```
Region:
Model:
SDK/version:
Request IDs:
Timestamp window (UTC):
Expected vs actual:
Retries enabled? (Y/N):
```

Elliot Price: Great. Conventions decision check:
1) External known issues live in redwood-docs
2) Confluence pages link out (not duplicating content)
3) Hub at `/help-center/known-issues/`
4) Filenames `workaround-...` and titles “Workaround: ...”
5) Each article must have “When to escalate” + diagnostics block

Dev Patel: Works for Support. :thumbsup:

Wei Chen: :thumbsup: I’ll coordinate with SDK docs owners to add a “Troubleshooting” section and link hub + streaming article.

Kira Thompson: :thumbsup: I’ll take first pass on Dedicated/Private article templates to ensure we don’t leak internal-only steps.

Mina Haddad: +1. I’ll drop suggested tags and a short glossary for routing/fallback terms so we’re consistent.

Elliot Price: Action items:
- Elliot: update IA + add checklist + create hub stub in redwood-docs (ties to ENG-4826)
- Wei: draft SDK cross-link language for streaming troubleshooting (ties to ENG-4827)
- Kira: template + review lane for Dedicated/Private content
- Dev/Priya: confirm slug list from Support macros so we don’t churn URLs

Dev Patel: I’ll post the current shortlist + preferred slugs from Support by EOD. Also: please avoid putting “P0/P1” language on external pages—keep it “Severity/impact” customer-friendly.

Elliot Price: Noted. We’ll keep it customer-facing and point internal severity mapping to Confluence only.
